text:
DeployBot: alert: embeddings latency p95 +35% vs baseline in dedicated-pool-5 after v4.0.0 rollout. auto-revert score=0.58 :warning:
Priya K: ack. impact scope? any customer-visible errors?
DeployBot: impact: dedicated-pool-5 (2 tenants), small traffic slice. error-rate unchanged, but embedding recall drop on internal eval.
Jonah M: given the score <0.6 and SLAs, we should not let auto-revert act. Need manual decision + legal notification.
Priya K: agree. we need to avoid surprise for those customers. can we pause new traffic to v4.0.0 and pin back to v3.9.9 for the pool?
Mike L: yes — soft unwind first. runbook: 1) pause routing to v4.0.0 for pool, 2) pin v3.9.9, 3) rollback, 4) run QA smoke, 5) send customer note. Owner?
Priya K: I'll own the ops steps. Jonah, can you handle comms?
Jonah M: will draft. keep it simple: "We reverted a recent model update for a small subset of dedicated customers due to degraded embedding quality. No data exposure. We're investigating."
LegalBot: auto: flagging — if rollback affects SLA, notify Legal within 30m. Recommend capture of timestamps and affected tenants for contract review.
Priya K: noted. we'll capture logs and tenant IDs. Mike, confirm change window status.
Mike L: change window closes in 18 minutes (at 20:00 UTC). If rollback extends past window, blameless customer notice required; Ops must coordinate with on-call to extend window.
Priya K: we'll do the pin+rollback now and aim to finish in <10m. suppress auto-revert.
DeployBot: suggested commands:
```
redwood traffic set-policy --route=embeddings --targets=dedicated-pool-5 --policy=hold
redwood release pin v3.9.9 --targets=dedicated-pool-5
redwood deploy rollback --to v3.9.9 --scope=dedicated-pool-5
```
Priya K: executing pin...
Priya K: pin succeeded. starting rollback in 60s.
Priya K: rollback complete.
QA-Bot: smoke results: embed recall restored to within 0.8% of baseline on canary tenant. no errors in logs.
Jonah M: sending customer notes now. subject: "Brief interruption: model revert for embeddings" body: short, non-technical + link to status page and follow-up PM.
LegalBot: auto: received notification. creating ticket LEG-342 for contract review.
Mike L: good. change window will still end in ~7m. Ops: extend window by +30m to cover postmortem if needed.
Priya K: opened PM-4530 and attached logs and smoke report. https://pm.internal/4530
DeployBot: log entry: manual rollback executed by Priya K; auto-revert suppressed by operator.
Jonah M: next steps: run full regression against larger embed eval in staging with v4.0.0-alpha and quantized variant before any re-rollout. assign to eng-ml.
Priya K: thanks all — closing after PM and LEG ticket are linked in handbook.
Mike L: thumbs. good coordination. :thumbsup:
